content.what_it_is: Case-local GNU make configuration. Lines 2-7 select the FUNWAVE and work directories, GNU compiler, parallel build, executable name, and single precision. Lines 9-20 enumerate ten optional preprocessor flags as commented choices. Lines 22-32 set compiler/MPI/debug and composed include/library variables. Line 35 imports the shared essential make rules. Lines 37-89 document targets and variables, and lines 90-119 provide a fully commented legacy-layout example with double precision and mass-conservation enabled.
entities: DEFINE FLAGS optional model features FLAG_1 through FLAG_10 (lines 9-20)
uncommon options and composed build variables (lines 22-32)

params_defined.name: FUNWAVE_DIR
params_defined.range: absolute or relative path; . for current directory

params_defined.name: MPI
params_defined.range: openmpi, MPImpich, or intelmpi as documented

calls: make, make clean, make clean-exe, make clobber, make chec-env, and make print-foo documented targets (lines 42-54)
unresolved: Line 50 documents a make target as chec-env, but this file defines no targets locally and the included rules are not present in this document, so the spelling cannot be resolved here.
Lines 52-54 describe make print-foo but the example uses make print $(EXEC), leaving the intended invocation inconsistent.
The notes misspell defined variables: PRESICION at line 70 versus PRECISION at line 7, SPHIRICAL at line 79 versus SPHERICAL at line 25, and DEF_FFC at line 77 versus DEF_FC at line 23.
Line 62 says to set FUNWAVE_DIR=. while it is inside the WORK_DIR note begun at line 60, so the intended variable in that instruction is unclear.
